synopsis.en: A big brother tries to work out why his baby sister keeps crying, and what she might be telling him.
synopsis.id: Seorang kakak laki-laki mencoba memahami mengapa adik bayinya terus menangis, dan apa yang mungkin ingin disampaikan adiknya.

before.en: Babies can’t talk yet. How do you think they tell us what they need?
before.id: Bayi belum bisa bicara. Menurutmu bagaimana mereka memberi tahu apa yang mereka butuhkan?

during.en: Each time the baby cries, pause: what could she need now?
during.id: Setiap kali bayi menangis, berhenti sejenak: apa yang mungkin ia butuhkan sekarang?

after.en: How did the brother feel at the start, and at the end?
after.id: Bagaimana perasaan sang kakak di awal, dan di akhir?

montessori.en: Care for a doll together: feed, wrap and rock it, naming each step.
montessori.id: Rawat boneka bersama: beri makan, selimuti, dan timang, sambil menyebut setiap langkah.
